notes.title: Fixes Sept. 13th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Game now pauses when the app loses focus.
[*] Fixed some bugs related to audio volume states not saving on restart.
[/list]

notes.title: First-Person View Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added first-person camera, just click the right stick or right mouse button.
[*] Continuing to refine the controls so that they feel good on both controller and keyboard.
[*] Stabilized the Millipede more, so it flips over less often.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Achievements!
[*] Added dead zone for analog steering to fix drift
[*] Player can now turn the millipede when stuck on a wall or colliding with itself. Hold acceleration and steer in place!
[*] Follow camera can now be tilted up and down
[*] More adjustments to steering sensitivity and damping 
[*] Fixed collision bugs in the ocean level
[*] Rollover recovery height adjusted to mitigate instances of rolling downhill over and over.
[*] New leg animation
[/list]

notes.title: Update August 12th, 2025
notes.content:
[*]Implemented the DLSS plugin for Unreal 5.6 and re-enabled the graphics setting 
[*]Upgraded the engine to 5.6.1
[*]Lowered steering sensitivity

notes.title: UI patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removing the millisecond digits from the game clock display
[*] The win screen still shows all the digits
[*] The clock now fades out after not collecting pellets for a time
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1][b]Hi Friends![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]It's been a busy summer working on Millispeed. I've added lots of new features, music, and control tuning to make this game as fun as possible, and far less frustrating to play than it has been.

If you haven't played in a while now's the time to give it another try![/p][h1]
Features:[/h1][list][*][p]New background music[/p][/*][*][p]New audio settings panel for turning off the new background music[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped forest map[/p][/*][*][p]Game clock[/p][/*][*][p]Timers and text to indicate the player's danger/safety during crow encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the pellet sizes and hitboxes to be more generous[/p][/*][*][p]Steering damping to make the millipede easier to control[/p][/*][*][p]Collision updates to make the millipede slide past itself and obstacles easier[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1][list][*][p]Crows shouldn't get stuck anymore[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual glitch on the millipede's carapace[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed falling off the landscape soft-locking the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed edge cases where the crow sequence continues even if the millipede is safe[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with the leg-counter fading out when it's not supposed to[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Millipede material adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p]And probably a lot more!

Thank you all so much for wishlisting and checking out the build. Your feedback has been instrumental in making Millispeed a better game.
[/p]

notes.title: Update for August 2nd
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added fade-ins to the music to make transitions less jarring.
[*] Increased steering damping.
[*] Bug fixes related to crows getting stuck
[*] UI bug fixes related to fade-in/out animations
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Millipede Controls
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Refining the steering, especially on keyboard. The millipede should be easier to control, especially when making small steering adjustments.
[*] Fixed a bug where falling through the floor causes a soft lock.
[*] Smoothed out landscape on parts of the map.
[*] Fixed visual artifacts on Millipede's shell material that would randomly appear per segment.
[/list]

notes.title: More changes, and new music!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 2 new music tracks, and refactored the music system.
[*] Lots of changes to steering sensitivity with keyboard and controller.
[*] Adjusted landscape to be shallower, and more forgiving.
[*] Made the pellets bigger, and increased the range for collecting them so they're less difficult to grab.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch for July 18th
notes.content:
Hotfix

[*]Fixed the lighting and fog inconsistencies between scalability settings and DirectX 11 vs 12
[*]Adjusted millipede steering sensitivity
[*]Made the millipede even less likely to roll over
[*]Adjusted the logic for hiding from crows. You have to stay in cover for a certain amount of time before the crow attack will end.

notes.title: Update for July 17th 2025
notes.content:
Lots of improvements in this week's build:

[*]More work on the Millipede's physics to make flipping over occur less often.
[*]The millipede now sticks to slopes better.
[*]Added a UI element to indicate when you've reached safety during a crow attack.
[*]Added a sound effect that more clearly indicates when you have reached safety.
[*]Completely redesigned forest map. It's got bigger slopes and is overall smoother so you can go faster. This version is still very early but improvements are coming.
[*]Added invisible walls around the forest level. Falling off the map shouldn't be possible anymore.
[*]Added music to the main game, and a volume control menu.
[*]2 new music tracks.
[*]Crows make ambient calls to indicate when they're near.

Known issues:

[*]Millipede gets stuck in a loop of flipping over on steep downhills, until reaching flat ground.
[*]Crows getting stuck sometimes.
[*]Millipede segments don't have gravity.
[*]Millipede randomly changes direction on occasion.
[*]Checkboxes in Menus aren't highlighted with a controller

notes.title: July 9th Update
notes.content:
Hello Millipedes!

Lots of fixes and changes in today's update.

[list]
[*]Fixed crows for real this time. They now patrol after respawning instead of getting stuck.
[*]Removed a bunch of crow instances, but fixed their patrols so they cover a larger area.
[*]Ferns now offer protection from crows
[*]Removed collision glitch when near a crow.
[*]Lots of movement changes.
[*]Added steering damping at high speed
[*]Boost speed has been doubled.
[*]Millipede starting speed and pellet speed value increased.
[*]Millipede should get stuck far less often, both on itself and logs/trees. When in doubt, boost to get out!
[*]Stronger anti-roll for millipede movement.
[*]UI adjustments to make closing the menu more intuitive.
[*]Dark color scheme for control map.
[*]Small change to the mega-pellet sound FX.
[/list]

notes.title: July 5th Update
notes.content:
New changes this week:

[list]
[*]Controller map texture updated
[*]The millipede is now much faster
[*]Adjusted steering sensitivity in relation to speed
[*]Smoothed out the starting area landscape
[*]Lots of little fixes for crows. They weren't working correctly in the last build
[*]The millipede now leans when turning
[/list]

My ultimate goal is for the millipede to flip less often, and to get stuck much less often.

notes.title: June 30th Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added default control mapping graphic for now, until I can build an input menu.
[*] UI adjustments
[*] Increased millipede acceleration
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Millispeed!
notes.content:
[b]The playtest has begun! [/b]

Thank you all so much for signing up and showing your support.

[list]
[*]Lots of updates to the menus to add more stylistic consistency.
[*]Fixed mode toggle at the beginning of the game not working correctly.
[*]UI improvements. 
[*]Player HUD now fades away completely, leaving an unobstructed view of the game.
[/list]

Please feel free to leave a comment in the community page. I'd also love to see your screenshots.

[b]There's so much more to come![/b] 
I'm hoping to work mainly on environments next.
